text: Create background music for a text strategy game about rebuilding civilization after the apocalypse. Setting: urban cluster/nation. Orchestral, solemn, with a sense of forward movement but not militaristic. No lyrics, no intelligible speech, no voice-over. Natural, complete phrases with a gentle beginning and ending; no sudden loud sounds. Suitable for long loops at low volume.
Urban cluster/nation

Create an original instrumental score: soft sustained synth tones and chamber strings, with the clear, open atmosphere of a futuristic city. Quiet and hopeful, with a touch of the unknown. Slow harmonic changes. No lyrics, vocals, voice-over, or heavy beats. Do not imitate any existing work. Steady volume, gentle beginning and ending, suitable for long loops in a text game.
